versions.subject: Update
versions.detection:
selection_root:
    Image|endswith: '\wusa.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: '/extract:'
selection_paths:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'C:\Users\Public\'
        - '\Desktop\'
        - '\Downloads\'
        - '\Appdata\Local\Temp\'
        - '\Windows\Temp\'
        - '\PerfLogs\'
condition: all of selection_*
